source_group_binding: Complete TRAIN/DEV group IDs are not listed in the manifest. Bind membership through exact export hashes; actual audit derives sorted group-ID digests/counts and verifies manifest raw-development subset membership without publishing IDs.
grains: One source-game group/current root has FREE, selected_a and selected_b presentations. Root material counts use complete three-mode groups once; per-mode and combined move counts use valid presentations. Invalid, duplicate, missing, extra and incomplete groups retain explicit denominators. Root mover presence is multi-label and counts each piece at most once per root.

derivations.target_first_move: Exactly one complete BEST_MOVE atom parsed with the pinned pure native parser and legally replayed; supplied selected move must match. No critical-line or rationale scoring.
derivations.immediate_facts: Python-chess legal move, mover before promotion, capture/victim including en passant, gives_check, checkmate, double check, promotion and castling. Quiet_immediate means only noncapture+noncheck.
derivations.material: P=1,N=3,B=3,R=5,Q=9,K=0. Nonpawn bands total both sides excluding pawns/kings:0..13,14..38,39+. These are descriptive material bands, not inferred game phase or evaluation.
derivations.king_coverage: Target king moves and king moves giving check; root legal king-move count includes castling. No claim of strategic or broad coaching coverage.
derivations.overlaps: Distinct source-game group IDs, case IDs, normalized board.fen() first4 state, normalized full6 FEN, and exact native.input_packet-normalized generator JSON (including empty history) are counted separately. A first4 collision alone is not full input leakage.

existing_evidence_reused: Prior independent corpus audit already established source locations, quotas, teacher/target coherence and intended selected check balance. New information here is aggregate target-piece/side/capture/material/king coverage and root-versus-presentation weighting, with a small TRAIN/DEV-only consistency check.
limitations: No reserve, held, evaluation reference, teacher or historical source files may be opened; only manifest metadata and the two exports. No fresh held quality affects this plan.
No actual game IDs, FEN rows, raw targets or corpus excerpts in aggregate output. Only counts, rates, categorical definitions and file/group hashes.

Counts describe this deliberately selected puzzle-derived snapshot. Class balance is an intended design, not corruption or proof of representativeness. Material and immediate quietness do not establish strategic coverage.
No model-quality scoring, new training, reweighting, reselection, rewriting, reservation changes, engine/model/framework calls, new downloads or automation.
No game timestamps are available in these exports. Freshness is the pinned snapshot identity, not a temporal game-quality assessment.

Cross-split risk checks cover TRAIN versus DEV only, not all historical data or reserved panels. Native first-move parsing checks target validity only; broader prose/PV quality remains outside this audit.
authorization: Root dispatch only after complete source/test/plan review and independent GO. No actual aggregate run has occurred.
